name: LibreTranslate
description: A machine-translation server and API that runs entirely on this machine, with the Argos Translate models for the languages you choose downloaded once onto its volume at first start.

access.note: LibreTranslate has no accounts and, as deployed, no API keys: anyone who reaches the address can translate, and each request costs this server CPU. Keep the domain behind the dashboard's password protection if strangers should not. The first start downloads a model for each language pair in the list (English to and from every other language listed), several hundred megabytes per pair, before the page answers; later starts reuse the volume and are quick.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

inputs.name: languages
inputs.label: Languages
inputs.description: Comma-separated language codes whose models are downloaded at first start. Every pair is between English and a listed language, so keep en in the list; each extra language adds two models and their download time.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The translation page and the API

volumes.name: models
volumes.purpose: The downloaded translation models; large, kept across redeploys, re-downloadable so not backed up

update.notes: A newer image may want newer models; it downloads what the language list needs and keeps using what is already on the volume. Nothing else is stored.
